Subject: Post-demo: security follow-up, SOC 2 status & IR timelines

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps from our side as they relate to security & compliance: 

Key items you asked about: 
- SOC 2: current status and what we can share (summary + evidence list).
- Data residency / GDPR: how customer data is partitioned and deletion workflows.
- HIPAA / PHI handling: isolation, BAAs (we do offer BAAs for covered use cases).
- Incident response (IR): breach notification timeline, sample playbook, and confirmation on notification windows.
- Vendor questionnaire: we can initiate a OneTrust/DocuSign flow for the formal questionnaire if you prefer.

Immediate next steps we propose: 
1) I will share a SOC 2 summary and a draft IR notification timeline (attached).
2) Jasmine will coordinate the technical answers around data flows and encryption.
3) If you can send the vendor questionnaire link or tell us preferred format, we can initiate.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with our Security lead if there are high-risk items.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf (summary), IR_notification_timeline_draft.docx (draft timeline), BCP_DR_checks.csv (high-level checks)

Are those next steps okay? If so, what deadline do you have for completing the questionnaire?

Thanks,
Marcus

3) Vendor questionnaire: we have a OneTrust questionnaire; I'll attach the invite when I have it. In the meantime can you start the vendor intake form so our Security Ops team can review?

Elena (cc: Marcus) — looping in the technical and compliance folks from our side. Below are concrete answers and asks so we can move the questionnaire and procurement cadence forward.

SOC 2:
- Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30.
- We can provide a redacted report and a control-matrix extract that maps to common OneTrust questions; see attached: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf. Full attested report requires an NDA/Controlled sharing flow; we can do that with your legal/procurement contacts.

IR / Breach notification (HIPAA/PII):
- Standard notification windows we provide:
  • Initial detection acknowledgement: within 4 hours of confirmed detection.
  • Preliminary assessment and customer notification (if customer data is impacted): within 24–72 hours depending on severity.
  • Final incident report with remediation actions: within 30 days (may vary for regulatory reporting).
- Our IR playbook includes: incident classification, customer notification templates, forensics retention policy, and escalation to CISO if Severity >= 3.
- Attached: IR_notification_timeline_draft.docx (editable draft you can feed into your intake).

Data residency / GDPR / Data subject requests:
- We support EU region deployments; for hosted customers we offer region pinning. Data deletion workflows and DSR handling are documented and we can provide process diagrams in the questionnaire.

Vendor questionnaire next steps:
1) Marcus: confirm whether NovaMed will accept a redacted SOC2 + control matrix or require the full attested report.
2) Neha/Monica: please prepare answers to OneTrust items for encryption, key management (KMS), access controls, and retention.
3) Marcus: please confirm the deadline (30 Sep) and whether the OneTrust link will be the primary intake.

Attachments included in this thread (for internal use / sharing per NDA):
- SOC2_summary_2024.pdf (redacted control matrix)
- IR_notification_timeline_draft.docx (editable timeline)
- BCP_DR_checks.csv (high-level recovery checks)

I will also start the OneTrust/Questionnaire flow from our side if you can forward the invite when it's ready.

—Jasmine
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming commitments and next actions so procurement has everything in one place: 

1) Deadline: we can meet your target of EOW 30 Sep for the vendor review provided we receive the OneTrust link by 23 Sep. If you need the full attested SOC 2 earlier, let us know — that will require an NDA and controlled file-transfer (we can accommodate).

2) SOC 2: redacted Type II summary attached (SOC2_summary_2024.pdf). We will prepare a control matrix export mapped to common OneTrust questions by 23 Sep.

3) IR / Breach notification: our standard notification windows are as Jasmine outlined — initial ack within 4 hours, customer notification within 24–72 hours depending on impact. For HIPAA-impacting incidents we default to the tighter end of that range and escalate to CISO immediately. If you have specific SLA language you need in a contract, please flag the clause and we will route to legal.

4) Vendor questionnaire: please send the OneTrust invite to security-portal@redwood.com and I will make sure Neha and Monica own the response. If OneTrust is not available, a PDF questionnaire works too.

5) Follow-up call: proposing Thu 25 Sep 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET — 30 min to walk through any high-risk controls and timeline expectations. Can you confirm?

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf, IR_notification_timeline_draft.docx, BCP_DR_checks.csv

Action owners: 
- Marcus: coordinate questionnaire intake and scheduling (owner)
- Jasmine: technical control answers (owner)
- Neha/Monica: complete OneTrust items for encryption/KMS/retention (owners)
- Rishi: assist on policy-level or legal redline questions (backup)

Thanks and looking forward to keeping this moving — happy to escalate if procurement needs anything faster.
